CustomField.description: Kill switch for the CRM Support Agentforce agent's actions. When true, agent action flows and Apex exit without performing writes (the agent stays reachable but goes read/escalate-only). Hierarchy setting: set at org level for a full stop, or per profile/user for scoped rollback. Part of the World-Class Agent Standard v2 §3 rollback-without-deploy requirement.
CustomField.label: Disable CRM Support Agent
